holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit reached Rs 17,389 crore for the quarter ended September 2026, while standalone profit stood at Rs 14,843 crore.
The bank's CASA ratio declined 340 bps to 36.1% as foreign currency non-resident deposits expanded.
ICICI Bank notified revisions to savings account select cash transaction charges effective December 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: As the fund's largest single bet at 7.98% weight, its -2.52% 3-month decline shaved 0.201% from fund returns, directly driving performance within the 30.2% Financials allocation.

watch.text: Implementation of revised savings account cash transaction charges from December 1, 2026.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit rose to Rs 10,012 crore on revenue of Rs 58,539 crore for the quarter ended June 2026.
The company introduced new postpaid plans offering free international roaming and launched an enterprise communications suite named IQ Gateway.
Airtel rolled out mass-market voice-only tariffs following a regulatory mandate from TRAI.
The Department of Telecommunications imposed several penalties for subscriber verification non-compliance.

holdings.why_it_matters: Occupying 4.36% of the portfolio in Technology, its -1.86% 3-month return created a mild drag, though 1-month momentum turned positive at 4.28%.

watch.text: Competitive dynamics and market response following the Reliance Jio Platforms public offer.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Quarterly net profit rose to Rs 21,537 crore on revenue of Rs 95,132 crore for the quarter ended September 2026.
HDFC Bank initiated an internal investigation into two senior executives regarding the unauthorized disclosure of confidential business information.
Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha will step down on December 31, 2026, while Lily Vadera was reappointed as independent director.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.59% portfolio weight, the stock's -7.12% 3-month decline generated an estimated -0.256% contribution drag, deepening the fund's 1-year drop of -2.93%.

watch.text: Leadership transition as Kaizad Bharucha concludes his tenure as Deputy MD on December 31, 2026.
Findings and regulatory implications of the internal probe into confidential data leakage.

holdings.name: Nestle India Ltd

what_changed.text: Sales for the quarter ended September 2026 rose 20.5% to Rs 6,782.2 crore, and net profit grew 36.3%.
The food regulator FSSAI issued notices regarding digestion claims on Lactogen Pro 1, prompting a formal response from the company.
The company announced a senior management reshuffle across its Nutrition, Dairy, and Chocolates verticals effective January 1, 2027.

holdings.why_it_matters: A sharp -17.82% return over 3 months created the fund's largest single drag (-0.617% contribution) at a 3.46% weight, pulling down the 5% Consumer Staples bucket.

watch.text: Executive leadership restructuring taking effect on January 1, 2027.
Regulatory determinations by FSSAI concerning Lactogen Pro 1 product claims.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: Net profit for the quarter ended June 2026 reached Rs 25,121 crore on total revenue of Rs 136,240 crore.
The bank confirmed a cyber incident involving dark-web exposure of 3,897 customer records detected on October 16, 2026.
SBI stated that customer account balances remain completely safe despite the breach.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.47% weight and a -4.21% 3-month return, it compounded the drag from top private lenders within the fund's 30.2% Financials exposure.

watch.text: Follow-up remediation and regulatory reviews following the reported dark-web customer data leak.

holdings.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit rose to Rs 5,998 crore in the June 2026 quarter on revenue of Rs 58,188 crore.
M&M's equity stake in NDET reduced from 72.07% to 49.63%, terminating its status as a step-down subsidiary.
Shares were transferred from the employees' stock option trust to grantees following option exercises on October 21, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Its -11.32% return over 3 months deducted an estimated 0.272% from fund performance at a 2.40% allocation, weighing on the Consumer Discretionary sleeve.

watch.text: Operational changes and consolidation impact after NDET ceased being a subsidiary.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The Reserve Bank of India approved Anup Kumar Saha as Managing Director & CEO for a three-year term starting January 1, 2027.
Provisional figures for Q2 FY27 showed net advances of Rs 5,77,094 crore and deposits of Rs 6,51,491 crore.
June 2026 quarter net profit stood at Rs 5,480 crore on revenue of Rs 18,355 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Gaining 14% over 3 months at a 2.06% weight, it delivered the second-highest positive contribution (+0.288%), partially cushioning weaknesses in peer banks.

watch.text: Board meeting on October 24, 2026 to review and approve Q2 and H1 FY27 results.
Formal leadership transition to Anup Kumar Saha taking effect on January 1, 2027.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 quarter net profit was Rs 23,196 crore on sales of Rs 309,468 crore.
ICRA reaffirmed RIL's AAA/Stable rating on debentures and assigned AAA/Stable to Rs 50,000 crore bank facilities.
The initial public offering of subsidiary Jio Platforms opened with a dedicated reservation for eligible RIL shareholders.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 1.96% allocation in Energy & Utilities, the stock shed 6.89% over 3 months and 19.16% over 1 year, acting as a sustained drag on fund capital.

watch.text: Finalization and market listing of the Jio Platforms IPO.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: In Q2 FY27, B2C net order value grew 54% YoY and adjusted revenue reached INR 24,621 crore.
The board sanctioned an internal restructuring of the Going-out India business along with an Adonmo stake swap for INR 156 crore in Mygate equity.
Net profit for the quarter ended September 2026 reached Rs 125 crore on revenue of Rs 24,138 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: A 6.04% 3-month gain at a 1.78% weight contributed +0.108%, making it the third-largest positive driver during a quarter when the fund fell 4.19%.

watch.text: Implementation of the Going-out India business reorganisation and closure of the Adonmo-Mygate share swap.

holdings.name: Titan Company Ltd

what_changed.text: Consumer businesses recorded 25% YoY growth in Q2 FY27, adding 78 retail stores to reach a total of 3,758.
The company fully repaid commercial papers worth Rs 825 crore and Rs 1,000 crore upon maturity in October 2026.
Quarterly net profit for June 2026 stood at Rs 1,777 crore on sales of Rs 21,356 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighing 1.58% in Consumer Discretionary, a -7.39% 3-month return reduced fund returns, counterbalancing its 1-year gain of 16.65%.

watch.text: Board review of unaudited Q2 FY27 financial results on November 5, 2026.

portfolio.statement: WhiteOak Capital Flexi Cap Fund declined 4.19% over the past 3 months, pulled lower by major bank and consumer holdings despite positive offset from mid-tier financials and internet platforms.
interp: Concentration in large-cap banking and discretionary franchises drove the recent drawdown as lenders faced internal governance or deposit headwinds.
Gains in select technology and growth names like Coforge, Kotak Mahindra Bank, and Zomato provided the primary source of positive alpha.
portfolio.line: Financials and consumer staples weakness outweighed gains in select tech and banking peers.

drivers.text: Sharp declines in Nestle India (-17.82%), Mahindra & Mahindra (-11.32%), and HDFC Bank (-7.12%) exerted the largest drags on the fund over 3 months.
Kotak Mahindra Bank rallied 14% on strong provisional advances and deposits alongside CEO appointment clearance.
Zomato added 6.04% over 3 months backed by 54% YoY growth in B2C net order value in Q2 FY27.

themes.title: Private Banking Divergence
themes.text: While Kotak Mahindra Bank gained on loan growth and regulatory clarity on leadership, HDFC Bank struggled under senior executive data leak probes and ICICI Bank faced CASA ratio moderation.

themes.title: Consumer Demand and Scrutiny
themes.text: Core consumer positions faced headwinds ranging from regulatory scrutiny on product claims at Nestle India to auto demand moderation at Mahindra & Mahindra, even as Titan expanded its store footprint.

macro.why: Margin and operational pressures emerged through dropping CASA ratios at ICICI Bank and data security investigations at HDFC Bank and State Bank of India.
Regulatory actions across infant nutrition at Nestle India and telecommunication subscriber verifications at Bharti Airtel introduced scrutiny on large consumer businesses.

priced_in.text: Market valuation for ICICI Bank factors in steady quarterly profit generation above Rs 17,000 crore despite CASA compression to 36.1%.
Zomato's high price-to-earnings multiple reflects rapid 54% YoY expansion in B2C net order value.

could_change.title: Outcomes of Bank Internal Inquiries
could_change.text: Findings from the leak investigation involving HDFC Bank executives could influence governance perceptions and valuation multiples.

could_change.title: Food Safety Regulatory Directives
could_change.text: Regulatory decisions regarding Lactogen Pro 1 claims could affect brand reputation and compliance costs for Nestle India.

portfolio.risk_note: A 30.2% concentration in Financials exposes the portfolio to sector-wide asset quality, deposit re-pricing, and regulatory risks across its core holdings.
